scope: Recorded independent QEMU 11.1.2 Cortex-A8 run. All register and FPSCR bits compared; no masking. Source-derived expectations remain authoritative where this model disagrees.

calibration.scope: Independent QEMU calibration only; compare primary D11 before treating it as an oracle.

fixture_error_excluded.scope: Fixture-only error; excluded from semantic oracle results
fixture_error_excluded.cause: Thumb function symbols already carry bit0=1. Adding1 changes the entry address/state.
fixture_error_excluded.correction: Load the symbol then OR bit0, preserving its encoded address.
fixture_error_excluded.verification: llvm-readelf -s on the failed ELF verifies the low Thumb function bit; the corrected BX fixture completed2128 cases.
